name: Fernando de Noronha
blurb: Online discussions regarding Fernando de Noronha focus on local wildlife, airport infrastructure updates, and adjustments to visitor fees. Recent posts also note incidents of aircraft wheels getting stuck due to asphalt collapses on the airport apron.

positive: Good diving conditions with warm water and marine life
Reopening of Buraco do Galego with new rules
negative: Airport asphalt sinking and trapping aircraft wheels
Debates regarding local security and shark management

quotes.text: Gol 737 gets stuck on the apron of Fernando de Noronha Airport after the asphalt gave way. It is the second time in a week that a plane has been stranded on the island for this reason. On June 22, a Azul Embraer 195-E2 faced the same problem.
